what: Clicking a link to another page on the same site shrinks a clone of the current screen to .94 (.6s power3.inOut) while darkening it by .4 (.6s power2.out). An accent-color curtain rises from below in .6s power3.inOut to cover it, then the page navigates. The new page opens with the curtain already laid, and the body rises from below by one screen height in .8s power3.out to cover the curtain. If .5s has not passed since the click, it waits the remainder before rising

options.shrink: Scale the old screen shrinks to, default .94
options.dark: Darkness laid over the old screen, default .4
options.hold: Minimum time from press until the new screen rises (s), default .5

note: The original is a single-page app (Next router) that swaps only the body behind the curtain. For use across multiple html files, the part passes ‹transition in progress› through sessionStorage and plays the reveal on the new document

from.where: shared.js page transition (old screen clone .94·darkness .4·forest-green curtain → new body rises .8s)
